If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overconfidence bias.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) over last 5 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative within 3 days, reduce forecast slope by 20–30% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent momentum overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, cap upward movement at +1.0% for late horizon to avoid overestimating recovery.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, cap downward movement at -1.0% for late horizon to avoid overestimating collapse.  
If sentiment is mixed (alternating ±0.33) over last 7 days, apply 0.5–1.0% smoothing to forecast path for mid horizon to dampen volatility amplification.
